implementation: Generalizes the existing scalar integer matrix contraction loop to select strict float64 multiplication, using the existing type-aware adjacent reduction tree and eight-byte scratch/output checks. The float32 tiled SIMD path is unchanged.

numerical_contract.products: strict IEEE binary64 nearest ties to even, rounded before summation
numerical_contract.sums: row-major contraction, balanced adjacent pairs, unchanged odd tails
numerical_contract.zero_inner: positive-zero output cells without input reads or arithmetic
numerical_contract.zero_output: preserves shape, skips contraction work and contraction-sized scratch
numerical_contract.performance_scope: scalar float64 correctness baseline; float64 tiling/vectorization deferred under the same numerical contract

qualification.scope: Focused qualification and regression run, not the full 327-test suite
coverage: 8192 sampled single-product operand pairs, boundary and 512 random matrices
APFloat separately rounded products and adjacent sums, including an FMA-sensitive counterexample
signed zero, subnormals, finite extremes, infinity and NaNs
padded/displaced, non-square transposed and aliased immutable input views
eight ARM rounding/flush-to-zero/default-NaN environments and no FP exception flags
typed retained result backing survives invocation settlement
negative/mismatched dimensions, eight-byte output/scratch limits, bounded empty shapes
allocation failures and cooperative cancellation publish no successful result
ordinary and builtin-spawn, nested/cached/aliased task handles
worker zero-contraction and empty-column results, typed layout impostor rejection
integer sibling fault recovery reuses owned tensor data in fresh work
invocation allocation injection positions 1-24 with 1/2/4 workers, cancellation/deadline/admission, zero live owners
mismatched typed IR and unsupported numerical policy rejection
Metal float64 remains rejected while preserving destination artifact
